title: Full algebraic degree APN functions
summary: Determine whether an APN vectorial Boolean function can attain algebraic degree equal to its dimension.

formal_statement.body: Does there exist an APN function $F:\mathbb F_2^n\to\mathbb F_2^n$ with algebraic degree $\deg(F)=n$? Construct such a function or prove nonexistence for every dimension.

assumptions: Algebraic degree uses the source vectorial Boolean-function convention
scope.unresolved_remainder: Corollary 3.9 excludes APN functions having a component exactly equal to $x_1x_2\cdots x_n$. Components of the form $x_1x_2\cdots x_n+g$ with nonzero lower-degree $g$ remain possible; construct a full-degree APN function or prove global nonexistence.

progress.summary: The TIT source explicitly states this unresolved problem and fixes its mathematical scope.
Corollary 3.9 proves that no APN function has a component exactly equal to the full monomial x_1 x_2 ... x_n; it does not exclude full-degree components with lower-degree terms.
